meta.title: Lesson 24: Check the AI Answer
meta.title_zh: 第 24 课：检查 AI 的答案

study_card.main_practice: 跟读 + 精读 + 中文讲解对照
study_card.suggested_pace: 先猜大意 · 再听读 · 最后完成英文输出

segments.en: The AI gives me a confident answer. I do not trust the tone by itself. I check the code in my own project. I run a small test and compare the result with the answer. The test is the judge.
segments.tts: The AI gives me a confident answer. I do not trust the tone by itself. I check the code in my own project. I run a small test and compare the result with the answer. The test is the judge.
segments.zh: AI 给了我一个听起来很自信的答案。我不会只相信语气，而是在自己的项目里检查代码。我运行一个小测试，把结果和答案比较。测试才是裁判。讲解：confident=自信的，tone=语气，judge=裁判，compare=比较。

segments.en: The answer uses a library function I do not know. I open the official documentation. The documentation says the function has a limit. The AI did not mention the limit. I add the missing detail to my note.
segments.tts: The answer uses a library function I do not know. I open the official documentation. The documentation says the function has a limit. The AI did not mention the limit. I add the missing detail to my note.
segments.zh: 答案使用了一个我不认识的库函数。我打开官方文档，文档说这个函数有一个限制，而 AI 没有提到。我把缺失细节补进笔记。讲解：library=库，official=官方的，documentation=文档，limit=限制。

segments.en: AI is useful for a first draft, not a final authority. I keep the helpful part and correct the weak part. My responsibility is to check before I use the answer.
segments.tts: AI is useful for a first draft, not a final authority. I keep the helpful part and correct the weak part. My responsibility is to check before I use the answer.
segments.zh: AI 适合做第一稿，不是最终权威。我保留有用部分，修正薄弱部分。在使用答案前进行检查，是我的责任。讲解：draft=草稿，authority=权威，responsibility=责任，correct=修正。

chunks.eg: Do not trust the tone by itself.
AI can make a first draft.

patterns.t: I do not trust X by itself.

transfer_tasks.task: Write a review comment about checking an AI answer. Use run a small test, official documentation, and a first draft.
